This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation Portal ↗.

The technical information on Axtroid products in terms Quick Start, User Manuals, Service Manuals, FAQs, etc. are available through the Axtroid Documentation Portal ↗.

Any changes triggered can be edited and made live.

Prerequisites

Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.

Note  Download the DocStudio application. Contact Admin.
Once the application is downloaded, click to open it.
Make sure you see instructions page.
Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.
Click ⚙️icon on the top left, to edit GitHub Settings.
Fill the details as shown below then click Connect.
Owner: axtroid
Repo: documentation
Path: docs/index.html (obtain it from your admin)
Branch: main
Personal access token: (obtain it from you admin)
Important  Refresh (F5 or Ctrl+R) to load the latest content from the server.
Updates:28/7/26
